blocks.text: Yeh unit model building aur data visualization par hai, ta ke students data ko analyze karna (jaanchna), samajhna aur achhe tareeqe se present karna (dikhana) seekhein. Aham topics:

items: Asal duniya ke problems hal karne mein statistical models ka role (kirdar) aur importance (ahmiyat) samajhna.
Basic statistical models (maslan linear regression) banana aur sahi metrics (naapne ke tareeqon) se un ki performance check karna.

Data science mein experimental design samajhna, jis mein hypothesis testing (andaze ko data se jaanchna), control groups (muqable wala group jis par koi tabdeeli nahi ki jati) aur randomization (groups ko bina soche, randomly banana) shamil hain.
Data visualizations ki qismein aur un ke istemal dekhna (maslan bar charts, scatter plots, heatmaps).
Achhe visualizations banane ke tareeqe seekhna ta ke insights (kaam ki baatein) saaf tareeqe se samjhayi ja sakein.
Descriptive statistics (maslan mean, median, standard deviation) ke zariye data ko visualize karne ke faide samajhna, ta ke data ke trends ki summary ban sake aur unhein samjha ja sake.
MS Excel, Google Sheets, Python (Matplotlib) aur Tableau jaise tools se visualizations banane ki hands-on skills (khud kar ke seekhi hui maharat) haasil karna.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Summary hypothesis testing, randomization aur heatmaps ka naam leti hai, lekin chapter inhein detail mein nahi parhata. Chapter ki aham misalein: mean, median, mode (50, 60, 70, 80, 90); variance aur standard deviation (Class A 12.56 aur 3.54, Class B 454 aur 21.31); data jama karna (survey, observation, experiment); safai (Alie se Ali, ghayab grade); linear regression (Earnings = 100 + 40 × Customers); logistic regression (parhai ke ghanton se pass ka imkan); K-means (maths aur English se do clusters); aur charts (bar, line, histogram, scatter, boxplot).

items: Data jama aur saaf karein, khulasa banayein, model banayein aur jaanchein, phir results charts mein dikhayein.
